summary: Nathaniel Ledbetter was the Democratic candidate for Alabama House District 24 in the 2010 election. He later switched parties and won the same seat as a Republican in 2014, eventually becoming Speaker of the Alabama House.
community_and_local_ties: Deep municipal roots in Rainsville area
important_caveats: Evidence of conservatism comes from a 2013 retrospective memorandum, not pre-election voter encounters.
